practice_units.title: Area of a Parallelogram
practice_units.problem: Find the area of a parallelogram with a base of 8 cm and a height of 5 cm.
guidance: Identify the formula for the area of a parallelogram: Area = Base × Height.
Plug in the values: Base = 8, Height = 5.

practice_units.title: Circumference of a Circle
practice_units.problem: Calculate the circumference of a circle with a radius of 7 cm. (Use π = 22/7)
